text:
Nora: quick follow-up from the canary run. saw region-specific spike in partial responses in eu-west during 03/21 canary window. moving to action items + owners. summary: partial_ratio eu-west = 0.9% (baseline 0.12%), reconnects also up ~3x.

Ben: saw logs showing a flurry of KV eviction warnings right before truncated chunks. i'm confident there's an ordering/race issue at flush boundary. i'll own server fix and repro harness.

Sana: i'll own canary orchestration + metric diffs. we need an automated rollback on canary if partial_ratio delta > 3x baseline or absolute > 0.5%. i'll wire that into the canary runner.

Oliver: i'll take client-side backoff/handshake clamp; the client lib telemetry shows many clients retrying aggressively in eu-west. plan: add capped full-jitter backoff + handshake timeout of 2.5s behind feature flag.

Nora: listing short IDs so infra/product can track:
- FOL-201: Repro harness for mid-stream KV eviction + unit tests. owner: Ben. due: 2026-03-29.
- FOL-202: Safe-flush path that fences eviction callbacks per-stream. owner: Ben. due: 2026-04-07.
- FOL-203: Canary automation: auto-rollback if partial_delta >3x or partial_ratio >0.5%. owner: Sana. due: 2026-03-27.
- FOL-204: Client lib: capped full-jitter backoff + handshake clamp + reconnect_reason telemetry. owner: Oliver. due: 2026-03-31.
- FOL-205: Region synthetic hourly stream + 4-region heatmap dashboard. owner: Sana. due: 2026-03-30.

Ben: note on FOL-202: implementation will use per-stream fence token and `defer_flush()` when eviction_inflight==true. small perf impact expected; will measure p50/p95/p99.

Oliver: for FOL-204 i'll emit `reconnect_reason` values: handshake_timeout, server_error, network_io. sample snippet for jitter: `delay = min(max_backoff, base * 2**attempt) * random()` and will add an opt-in flag `client.backoff_v2`.

Sana: alerts update proposal:
- WARN: partial_ratio > 0.15% for 10m -> notify #incidents
- PAGE: partial_ratio > 0.5% for 5m OR region synthetic fail > 2 runs -> page oncall
Are those thresholds ok?

Nora: looks good. add one more: page if eu-west partial_ratio > 0.3% for 5m (region escalation).

ops-bot: created INFRA ticket INFRA-820 to add canary rollback hook and region toggle. link: https://redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-820

Sana: canary plan: run staged canary in eu-west only first, then eu+na combined. check-list for each canary day: (1) verify synthetic stream from 4 regions (2) check partial_ratio by route/model (3) validate p99 latency not regressing >20% (4) confirm reconnect_count normalized.

Ben: risk/rollback notes: safe-flush could increase final-chunk latency ~10-50ms for long streams; rollback path is flip `safe_flush` feature-flag and revert PR. will document exact revert steps in FOL-202 ticket.

Oliver: i'll add client opt-out flag so we can disable new backoff if necessary while server fixes roll out. also adding client telemetry to the dashboard so we can split server vs client causes.

Nora: schedule check-ins: daily stand for next 7 days at 09:00 UTC (10 min) until FOL-203 done, then weekly. Sana please create calendar invite.

Sana: ops-bot scheduled "Streaming follow-up standup" daily 09:00 UTC starting 2026-03-24 and created board: https://redwood.internal/remediations/1969007777

pagerduty-bot: created PD rule update PR for partial alerts and assigned to Nora. link: https://redwood.internal/pagerduty/rules/PR-314

Nora: owners recap: Ben (server repro + safe-flush FOL-201/202), Oliver (client backoff FOL-204), Sana (canary+synthetic+alerts FOL-203/205). next sync: 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC. post status updates to remediation board before the stand.

Ben: opening PR for repro harness today, will @mention Oliver for client interplay review.

Oliver: i'll review and add client tests for handshake edgecases.

Sana: closing thread for now, will reopen if canary shows new regressions. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
